name: Duke
description: Take 3 coins from the Treasury. May block Foreign Aid.

name: Assassin
description: Pay 3 coins to assassinate a target player; that player loses 1 influence.

name: Captain
description: Steal up to 2 coins from another player. May block stealing.

name: Ambassador
description: Draw 2 role cards from the deck, then return 2 cards. May block stealing.

name: Contessa
description: May block an assassination targeting you.

name: Coin
description: A coin token used for the Treasury, income, and payments.
